title: September-late and October 2026 intake production - batch H8 Tier A: four upheld genuine new roots and five targeted enrichments
note: H8 TIER A ONLY. Authorised by the Founder's H8 decisions of 2026-11-11 (FD-1/FD-2 approved, tiered; FD-6 mandatory independent root review). All ten proposed roots were upheld by a clean-context reviewer; Tier A is N01-N04 and E01-E05. Tier B (N05-N10) is conditionally approved and is NOT in this manifest; any Tier B item not qualified by 2026-11-14 18:00 IST moves to H8b. E06 (P/V settings) is deferred (FD-8). Every card passed a separate clean-context content review (TIER_A_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.md, private evidence) and its fixes were applied before these digests were taken. Counter normalisation: on QB8_B, QB5_J and QB7_I the header/section/count-label counters were set to the true card count (QB7_I's header had read 9 against 10 cards). No examiner attribution is minted (FD-5): no new or enriched card carries a data-examiner attribute and no added text names an examiner.
examiner_relationship_delta_note: Zero by construction: no data-examiner attribute and no STRONG_CE_TIP_REVIEW row added. H8 occurrences create no relationship rows; recurrence is recorded as matched_question_id in the private H8 adjudications (D-H7-3).
